summary: Apaxy is a custom theme designed to improve the usability and appearance of standard web directories. It overrides the default look of directory listings generated by the Apache mod_autoindex module using CSS and JavaScript.
goodFor: It is suited for administrators wanting to make raw file indexes hosted on Apache servers look cleaner and easier to navigate.
watchOut: The project has low maintenance activity and no recent tagged releases, meaning you may need to apply fixes yourself if it breaks.
deployNotes: Since it relies on client-side assets and the Apache mod_autoindex module, you typically only need to place the theme files into the target directory on your web server without requiring a database or complex runtime setup.
